analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI entering oversold territory, ADX at 21.5 in early trend formation stage. MACD histogram worsening continues. Volume ratio at 0.85, indicating contraction. Current price at 29,965 KRW, approaching swing support at 29,960 KRW. With volatility ATR at 1,842 KRW, setting stop loss at 1.3x ATR (2,395 KRW) yields stop price of 27,570 KRW, and target at 2x ATR (3,684 KRW) yields target price of 32,350 KRW. Risk-reward ratio is 1.53. For a buy entry, confirmation of breaking resistance at 30,570 KRW is required.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (29,965 KRW) vs SMA5 (30,822 KRW) / SMA20 (36,309 KRW) / SMA50 (35,364 KRW): below short-term, below mid-term, below long-term → weak trend position confirmed
· Below SMA100 (40,101 KRW) / SMA200 (35,943 KRW): maintaining long-term weak trend strength
· 52-week position (33.1%) + current price range slightly above 52-week low
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.9→32.6): entering oversold, downward momentum continues
· MACD histogram trajectory (-133.0989→-1138.9763): worsening continues, weak trend expansion
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 29,315 KRW): approaching lower band, band width at 38.52% expanded
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line (29,960 KRW): approaching current price, above Pivot S1 (25,355 KRW)
· Swing resistance line (30,570 KRW): above current price, potential for short-term rebound upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Higher Low not confirmed, Lower High not confirmed → sideways range diagnosis
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.85x): contracted compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in movement
· Current range diagnosis (accumulation phase): RSI entering oversold, ADX trend weak. Consider buy entry after resistance breakout, sell entry after support breakdown.
